Entry.JapaneseText: 聞き上手の乙女は人々の憧れの的、悩み深き人々の 苦悩を聞いて心を癒す。でも一番悩んでるのは自分
Entry.EnglishText: The saintess admired by all who heals the troubled by listening to their deepest woes. Yet it is she herself who is the most troubled of all.

Entry.JapaneseText: 修行中の法術師。大地と神に恩恵を賜るために、 その身を潔斎し、日々、慎ましやかに暮らす
Entry.EnglishText: A cleric in training. To receive the blessings of her goddess, she purifies her body and lives with utmost restraint.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル７、清廉潔白なる乙女はいつでも仲間内の良心。 個性豊かな仲間たちをなだめるみんなの抑え役
Entry.EnglishText: At level 7, this pure and virtuous maiden acts as the conscience of the group. She calms her colorful companions, serving as their stabilizing force.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１２、憔悴しきった戦士たちにいつでも はにかんだ優しい微笑みを振りまく、癒しの天使
Entry.EnglishText: At level 12, she is an angel who showers weary warriors with her shy and gentle smile.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２０、激しい戦いの後ろに立ち、その背中を 見つめる優しい瞳。回復はいつでも準備万端ＯＫ
Entry.EnglishText: At level 20, she standing behind the battle lines, gazing at her companion's backs with her gentle eyes, ready to heal at a moment's notice.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル４０、旅の仲間を支えるその貫禄はまるで みんなのお母さん。大いなる母性でみんなを包み込む
Entry.EnglishText: At level 40, her steadfast presence supports her companions like a mother's would. She envelops all with her motherly presence.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル８０、どんな言葉少なでも、そこにいるだけで 心強い。それがまさに法術師窮極の立ち位置
Entry.EnglishText: At level 80, even with her reserved nature, her mere presence is reassuring. That is the ultimate fulfillment of her role as a cleric.

Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 49 -With everyone present, approach the bridge in front of the mansion in [AC. 4354] Ninja Village.

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱血で真面目な恋人を陰からしっかり支える健気な心。 彼にただ従順なだけじゃない、言う時はちゃんと言う
Entry.EnglishText: A devoted lover who supports her fiery sweetheart in private. She refuses to be a pushover, and will speak up to him when needed.
Entry.Notes: Need another term for "pushover" - like a term for someone who always goes along with what her husband says, like a yes-woman.

Entry.JapaneseText: 白い法衣を身にまとい、清純派の装いの下は 鼻血ブーなくらいに、意外とグラマーらしい
Entry.EnglishText: Beneath her white robes and demure appearance is a surprisingly voluptuous figure - enough to make one's nose bleed.

Entry.JapaneseText: その昔、生粋なる乙女しか会えない一角獣に会い、 そのツノを手に入れたらしい。今も清廉さは健在
Entry.EnglishText: Long ago, she encountered a unicorn whom only pure maidens could meet and obtained its horn. Her purity remains intact to this day.
Entry.Notes:
Sub-Event: 58: Houjutsushi no Shukumei -Big Eye must be defeated -Talk to the three nuns inside the church in [AC. 4306] Toltus Village with Mint in the party
Might need to reword the first sentence.

Entry.JapaneseText: イシュタル伝説に伝わる破邪の杖を手に、 聖なる巫女の意思を継承して、戦いに挑む聖女
Entry.EnglishText: The saintess, wielding the staff of evil's bane passed down through Ishtar's legend, has inherited the Sacred Priestess' will and ventures into battle.
Entry.Notes: Will need review from context on the sub-event
